cues.zh: 你生命中的每一秒，都在遭受攻击。
cues.en: Every second of your life, you are under attack.

cues.zh: 数十亿的细菌、病毒和真菌，正试图把你变成它们的家园，
cues.en: Billions of bacteria, viruses, and fungi are trying to make you their home,

cues.zh: 所以我们的身体进化出了一支超级复杂的小型军队，有守卫、士兵、情报员、武器工厂和通信兵，
cues.en: so our bodies have developed a super complex little army with guards, soldiers, intelligence, weapons factories, and communicators

cues.zh: 来保护你免于……嗯……死亡。
cues.en: to protect you from...well...dying.

cues.zh: 在这期视频里，我们假设免疫系统有12种不同的职责。比如，消灭敌人、通信等等。
cues.en: For this video, let's assume the immune system has 12 different jobs. For example, kill enemies, communicate, etc.

cues.zh: 它还有21种不同的细胞和2支蛋白质部队。
cues.en: And it has 21 different cells and 2 protein forces

cues.zh: 这些细胞最多有4种不同的职责。
cues.en: These cells have up to 4 different jobs.

cues.zh: 我们来分配一下。这些是它们之间的相互作用。
cues.en: Let's assign them. Here are the interactions.

cues.zh: 现在，让我们把它讲得通俗易懂。
cues.en: Now, let's make this understandable.

cues.zh: 首先，给这些职责加上颜色。
cues.en: First of all, let's add colours to the jobs.

cues.zh: 现在，我们来画出这些细胞。
cues.en: Now, let's illustrate the cells.

cues.zh: 中心的颜色代表细胞的主要职责，
cues.en: The central colour represents the main job of the cell,

cues.zh: 而周围的颜色代表次要职责。
cues.en: while the surrounding ones represent secondary duties.

cues.zh: 现在免疫系统看起来是这样的。
cues.en: Now the immune system looks like this.

cues.zh: 接下来看看它们之间的相互作用。
cues.en: Now the interactions.

cues.zh: 这种复杂性是不是很棒？
cues.en: Isn't this complexity just awesome?

cues.zh: 本期视频我们只讨论这些细胞，其余的暂且忽略。
cues.en: For this video we will only talk about these cells and ignore the rest.

cues.zh: 那么，发生感染时会发生什么？
cues.en: So, what happens in the case of an infection?

cues.zh: *片头*
cues.en: *Intro*

cues.zh: 美好的一天，突然冒出一颗生锈的钉子，你划伤了自己。
cues.en: It's a beautiful day, when suddenly, a wild rusty nail appears and you cut yourself.

cues.zh: 免疫系统的第一道屏障被突破了：你的皮肤。
cues.en: The first barrier of the immune system is breached: your skin.

cues.zh: 附近的细菌抓住机会，进入了你的伤口。
cues.en: Nearby bacteria seize on the opportunity and enter your wound.

cues.zh: 它们开始消耗身体的资源，大约每20分钟数量就翻一倍。
cues.en: They start using up the body's resources and double their numbers about every 20 minutes.

cues.zh: 起初它们悄无声息，但当细菌数量达到一定程度时，
cues.en: At first, they fly under the radar, but when a certain bacteria population is reached,

cues.zh: 它们改变行为，通过改变周围环境来损害身体。
cues.en: they change their behavior and start to damage the body by changing the environment around them.

cues.zh: 免疫系统必须尽快阻止它们。
cues.en: The immune system has to stop them as fast as possible.

cues.zh: 首先，你的守卫细胞，也就是巨噬细胞，会介入。
cues.en: First of all, your guard cells, known as macrophages, intervene.

cues.zh: 它们是巨大的细胞，守卫着身体的每一个边界区域。
cues.en: They are huge cells that guard every border region of the body.

cues.zh: 大多数时候，它们单凭自己就能扼杀入侵
cues.en: Most of the time, they alone can suffocate an attack

cues.zh: 因为它们每只最多能吞噬100个入侵者。
cues.en: because they can devour up to 100 intruders each.

cues.zh: 它们把入侵者整个吞下，困在细胞膜里。
cues.en: They swallow the intruder whole and trap it inside a membrane.

cues.zh: 然后敌人被酶分解消灭。
cues.en: Then the enemy gets broken down by enzymes and is killed.

cues.zh: 此外，它们还会命令血管向战场释放水分，引发炎症
cues.en: On top of that, they cause inflammation by ordering the blood vessels to release water into the battlefield

cues.zh: 让战斗变得更容易。
cues.en: so fighting becomes easier.

cues.zh: 你会注意到这表现为非常轻微的肿胀。
cues.en: You notice this as a very mild swelling.

cues.zh: 当巨噬细胞战斗太久，
cues.en: When the macrophages fight for too long,

cues.zh: 它们会释放传递位置和紧急程度的信使蛋白，呼叫强力增援。
cues.en: they call in heavy backup by releasing messenger proteins that communicate location and urgency.

cues.zh: 中性粒细胞离开血液中的巡逻路线，奔赴战场。
cues.en: Neutrophils leave their patrol routes in the blood and move to the battlefield.

cues.zh: 中性粒细胞战斗得如此猛烈，以至于在这个过程中会杀死健康细胞。
cues.en: The neutrophils fight so furiously that they kill healthy cells in the process.

cues.zh: 除此之外，它们还会生成屏障，困住并杀死细菌。
cues.en: On top of that, they generate barriers that trap and kill the bacteria.

cues.zh: 它们确实如此致命，以至于进化出五天后自杀的机制，以防造成太大破坏。
cues.en: They are, indeed, so deadly that they evolved to commit suicide after five days to prevent them from causing too much damage.

cues.zh: 如果这还不足以阻止入侵，免疫系统的大脑就会介入。
cues.en: If this is not enough to stop the invasion, the brain of the immune system kicks in.

cues.zh: 树突状细胞开始活跃起来。
cues.en: The dendritic cell gets active.

cues.zh: 它对士兵们的信号作出反应，开始从敌人身上采集样本。
cues.en: It reacts to the signals of the soldiers and starts collecting samples from the enemies.

cues.zh: 它们把敌人撕成碎片，并将这些片段呈现在自己的外表面。
cues.en: They rip them into pieces and present the parts on their outer layer.

cues.zh: 现在，树突状细胞要做出一个关键决定。
cues.en: Now, the dendritic cell makes a crucial decision.

cues.zh: 是呼叫能消灭受感染体细胞的反病毒部队，
cues.en: Should they call for anti-virus forces that eradicate infected body cells

cues.zh: 还是召集一支细菌杀手大军？
cues.en: or an army of bacteria killers?

cues.zh: 这种情况下，抗菌力量是必要的。
cues.en: In this case, anti-bacteria forces are necessary.

cues.zh: 然后它大约一天内到达最近的淋巴结。
cues.en: It then travels to the closest lymph node in about a day.

cues.zh: 在这里，数十亿辅助T细胞和杀伤T细胞正等待被激活。
cues.en: Here, billions of helper and killer T cells are waiting to be activated.

cues.zh: T细胞诞生时要经历艰难而复杂的训练过程
cues.en: When T cells are born they go trough a difficult and complicated training process

cues.zh: 只有四分之一能存活下来。
cues.en: and only a quarter survives.

cues.zh: 存活的细胞配备了特定的配置。
cues.en: The surviving cells are equipped with a specific set-up.

cues.zh: 而树突状细胞正在路上寻找配置恰好合适的辅助T细胞。
cues.en: And the denditric cell is on its way looking for a helper T cell with the set-up that's just right.

cues.zh: 它在寻找一个辅助T细胞，能结合树突状细胞呈递在其膜上的入侵者片段。
cues.en: It's looking for a helper T cell that can bind the parts of the intruders which the dendritic cell has presented on its membrane.

cues.zh: 当它终于找到一个时，连锁反应就发生了。
cues.en: When it finally finds one, a chain reaction takes place.

cues.zh: 辅助T细胞被激活。它迅速复制数千次。
cues.en: The helper T cell is activated. It quickly duplicates thousands of times.

cues.zh: 有些变成记忆T细胞，留在淋巴结里，让你几乎对这种敌人免疫。
cues.en: Some become memory T cells that stay in the lymph node and will make you practically immune against this enemy.

cues.zh: 有些前往战场支援。
cues.en: Some travel to the field of battle to help out.

cues.zh: 第三组则前往淋巴结中心
cues.en: And the third group goes on to travel to the center of the lymph node

cues.zh: 去激活一个非常强大的武器工厂。
cues.en: to activate a very powerful weapons factory.

cues.zh: 和T细胞一样，它们天生就有特定的配置
cues.en: Like the T cells, they are born with a specific set-up

cues.zh: 当一个B细胞和一个配置相同的T细胞相遇时，场面就炸了。
cues.en: and when a B cell and a T cell with the same set-up meet, hell breaks loose.

cues.zh: B细胞迅速复制，开始生产数百万的小武器。
cues.en: The B cell duplicates rapidly and starts producing millions of little weapons.

cues.zh: 它们拼命工作，很快就会真的累死。
cues.en: They work so hard that they would literally die from exhaustion very fast.

cues.zh: 这时，辅助T细胞又发挥重要作用；它们刺激这些拼命工作的工厂，告诉它们：
cues.en: Here, helper T cells play another important role; they stimulate the hard working factories and tell them:

cues.zh: “先别死，我们还需要你，继续干！”
cues.en: "Don't die yet, we still need you, keep going!"

cues.zh: 这也确保了感染结束后工厂会停止运作，这样身体就不会浪费能量或伤害自己。
cues.en: This also ensures that the factories die if the infection is over so the body doesn't waste energy or hurt itself.

cues.zh: 但B细胞产生的是什么？
cues.en: But what is produced by the B cells?

cues.zh: 你当然听说过，抗体。
cues.en: You've heard of them of course, antibodies.

cues.zh: 这些微小蛋白质被设计来结合特定入侵者的表面。
cues.en: Little proteins that are engineered to bind to the surface of the specific intruder.

cues.zh: 甚至还有不同种类的抗体，各自承担略有不同的任务。
cues.en: There are even different kinds of antibodies that have slightly different jobs.

cues.zh: 辅助T细胞告诉浆细胞，在这次特定入侵中最需要哪种类型。
cues.en: The helper T cells tell the plasma cells which type is needed the most in this particular invasion.

cues.zh: 数百万个抗体涌入血液，充满全身。
cues.en: Millions of them flood the blood and saturate the body.

cues.zh: 与此同时，在感染部位，情况正变得危急。
cues.en: Meanwhile, at the site of infection, the situation is getting dire.

cues.zh: 入侵者数量已经倍增，并开始伤害身体。
cues.en: The intruders have multiplied in number and start hurting the body.

cues.zh: 守卫和攻击细胞奋力战斗，但也在过程中死亡。
cues.en: Guard and attack cells fight hard, but also die in the process.

cues.zh: 辅助T细胞支持它们，命令它们更具攻击性、活得更久。
cues.en: Helper T cells support them by ordering them to be more aggressive and to stay alive longer.

cues.zh: 但没有帮助，它们无法压倒细菌。
cues.en: But without help they can't overwhelm the bacteria.

cues.zh: 但现在，第二道防线到来了。
cues.en: But now, the second line of defense arrives.

cues.zh: 数十亿抗体涌入战场，使大量入侵者失效，
cues.en: Billions of antibodies flood the battlefield and disable lots of the intruders,

cues.zh: 让它们无能为力，或在此过程中杀死它们。
cues.en: rendering them helpless or killing them in the process.

cues.zh: 它们还使细菌麻痹，让它们成为容易的目标。
cues.en: They also stun the bacteria and make them an easy target.

cues.zh: 它们的背部构造用于连接杀手细胞，从而更容易连接并杀死敌人。
cues.en: Their back is built to connect to killer cells, so they can connect and kill the enemy more easily.

cues.zh: 巨噬细胞尤其擅长吞噬抗体附着的细菌。
cues.en: Macrophages are especially good at nomming up the bacteria which antibodies have attached to.

cues.zh: 现在平衡发生了转变。
cues.en: Now the balance shifts.

cues.zh: 在团队协作下，感染被清除了。
cues.en: In a team effort, the infection is wiped out.

cues.zh: 此时，数百万身体细胞已经死亡。
cues.en: At this point, millions of body cells have already died.

cues.zh: 没什么大不了的，损失很快得到补充。
cues.en: No big deal, the losses are quickly replenished.

cues.zh: 大多数免疫细胞现在已无用，没有持续的刺激信号它们就会自杀，以免浪费资源。
cues.en: Most immune cells are now useless and without the constant signals they commit suicide, so as not to waste any resources.

cues.zh: 但有些留了下来：记忆细胞。
cues.en: But some stay behind: the memory cells.

cues.zh: 如果将来再次遇到这种敌人，它们会做好准备，很可能在你察觉之前就把它消灭。
cues.en: If this enemy is encountered ever again in the future, they will be ready for it and probably kill it before you even notice.

cues.zh: 这是对免疫系统部分工作机制一个非常非常简化的解释。
cues.en: This was a very, very simplified explanation of parts of the immune system at work.

cues.zh: 你能想象这个系统有多复杂吗，即便在这个层面上，而我们还忽略了许多参与者以及所有的化学过程。
cues.en: Can you imagine how complex this system is, even at this level, when we ignore so many players and all the chemistry.

cues.zh: 生命极其复杂，但如果我们花时间去理解它，就会遇到无尽的奇迹与非凡的美。
cues.en: Life is awfully complicated, but if we take the time to understand it, we'll encounter endless wonders and great beauty.
